contexts.text: He then wants to be away from the company of the Angels...
Man is constantly in the company of Spirits... AC 5036. AC 5861.
For they breathed with the Angels in whose company they were.
When I have spoken with Spirits in the midst of a company of men... AC 5862:end.
Societies of Angels; companies of evil Spirits.
They perceive bliss from the company of little children...
The Most Ancient Church... lived in company with the Angels.
They are kept by the Lord in the company of Angels...
Such cannot be admitted into the company of good Spirits.
If he desires it, he is shown the society of Spirits in whose company he had been (while in this world).
Hence it is evident how dangerous it is for man to be in living company with Spirits, unless he is in the good of faith.
Conscience is the plane into which the Angels flow, and through which there is given consort with them.
Their internal man is in company with the Angels.
The man who is in these loves is in company with those who are in Hell. AR 937:3.
When I have been withdrawn from the body, and thus in company with the Angels...
In the golden age the Angels dwelt with men, and had consort with them as friends with friends.
Whenever I have been in company with the Angels... HH 174. HH 234. HH 255. HH 312:2.
Moral truths relate to those things which are of the life of every man in relation to associations and intercourse.
That a man's spirit is his own reigning love is manifested in every company in the other life...
They are led round... into various companies...
The state of the exteriors is such as the man was as to his spirit when in company. HH 504:2.
In the world there are... fellowships...
After some consort with others, he is associated with those who are in like evil.
Man is in manifest thought when his spirit is thinking in the body, which takes place especially when he is in company with others.

It is evident from the double state of the lungs in respiration, that man is able to think in one way... in company with others; and to think differently... when not in company... In companies where he is afraid of losing his character, he can speak... like a spiritual, moral, and civil man.
As every man is in company with Spirits as to his affections and thence his thoughts; an evil man with Spirits from Hell, and a good man with Angels from Heaven...
As there are companies there as in the natural world...
Heavenly joy supposed to consist in glad gatherings with Angels. CL 5.
There are in Heaven most joyous gatherings...
These cause the meetings between the sexes... to be heavenly sweetness itself.
Have sought from the Lord a lawful and lovely companionship with one of the sex...
Married partners there enjoy similar intercourse with each other...
Likenesses and unlikenesses (of character) originate through... the company that is kept, etc.
That such a friendship may exist between old married partners, experience testifies from their... intercourse, tranquil, secure, lovely, and full of courtesy.
They then put on the state and name of married partners and bed-fellows.
That intercourse with the evil there has this effect...
I once saw... so many companies conversing...
The diversions of charity are dinners, suppers, and social gatherings. General article.
As to social gatherings in the primitive Church, they were among such as called themselves brethren in Christ; they were therefore assemblies of charity, because there was spiritual brotherhood.
No one can explore the interiors of the mind of those with whom he is in company and intercourse. But this is not necessary...
Man's spirit is constantly in company with its like in the Spiritual World.
As the spirit changes its state... it is transferred to places in this or that quarter, and comes into company with those who dwell there.
Then he steals away from their company...
He then comes into the company of those who are like himself as to the affections of his will...
Spirits know from various things whether a soul is of such a character as to accord with their company.
I have been continually led from one company into another.
That even the evil and unbelieving speak and even believe truths when they are in company with good Spirits.
I was once in the company of the Angels, and I then had their firm faith, which I could not have had when out of the company of the Angels.

He supposed that because he could be in the company of the upright in the world, he could do the same in the other life... He was therefore permitted to enter into the company of the good Spirits who are above the forehead...
Otherwise he would have been without company...
